text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Referee
text_block_list.text:
And now, the second half of the Demon 
Dodgeball finals begins!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's finish this already. 
Now that your special move is useless, you 
don't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text: Take this—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Muuun!!!!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What...!? She caught it...!? 
Where does she still have the energy for 
that...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, I'm completely out of 
stamina... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even without stamina, we've got the bond 
of our team! 
...Just kidding! Laurel-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-chan's right! We're not giving 
up, 
not until the very end—Bourbon-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Limiter released. Switching mode to 'Give 
Everything'. 
Locking on to target: Team Penta Captain.

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Has Team Five Stars regained their 
composure!? 
They're closing in on Penta with 
completely transformed movements!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Here it goes—Special Move Number 2...!!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Special Move Number 2, you say...? 
Isn't that just a regular attack!? I've 
got this—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Towaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Catch successful! We will definitely, 
definitely not lose! 
Everyone, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Understood, over here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Pass it to me too, keep them coming!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is happening with Team Five 
Stars!? 
Attack or pass, the ball's speed is 
ramping up exponentially!!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text:
Hah, trying to confuse us!? 
A tactic like that will drain your stamina 
in no—whoa, whoops—!?

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She dodged it! Team Penta's captain barely 
evades! 
However, the ball is still in the hands of 
Five Stars!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nuoooooh, not yet! We'll do it as many 
times as it takes! 
Even if it squeezes out the very last drop 
of our stamina—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trusting in everyone, running together... 
That is our new 'Special Move'—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, we will observe no longer. Every 
one of us will challenge as an attacker. 
It is an extremely stamina-draining, 
reckless strategy, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We won't worry about how long our stamina 
will last! 
We just have to trust our friends and run 
with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A powerful desire to answer that 'trust'. 
Defined as the final factor that 
transcends physical limits.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let us go, with all our heart and soul—!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is...! They jumped! Every member 
of Team Five Stars 
leaps into the air! Passing the ball 
mid-air, and—

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text: Gh...! The backlight's blinding me...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is our answer. 
Connecting to shine even brighter—Meteor 
Fall Kai: Kizuna!!

text_block_list.name: Penta Captain
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaah!?!?

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It hits! An ultra high-speed passing play 
executed in mid-air, 
a ferocious assault masking the true 
attacker until the very end!!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The signal flare for Team Five Stars' 
counterattack has been raised!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Demon Dodgeball was heated once again this 
year! 
Especially the finals—it was anyone's game 
right until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Demon Dodgeball Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And now, let us welcome the championship 
team to the stage! 
—Team Five Stars!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your support! 
Team Five Stars managed to take the 
victoryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Way to go~! O-Machi-chan! Bakushin O-chan 
and everyone else too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hwah-hah-hah-hah! A result most fitting 
for us, I should say! 
After all, this team was led by none other 
than your Class President!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission 'Win Demon Dodgeball' 
accomplished. 
—Confirmed 'smiles' from Flower-san and 
Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Everyone's joyful cheers are 
echoing all around us... 
Is this what you wanted to see, 
Ikuno-chan?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And it is also what I wanted to show 
you all. 
This scenery, which we have reached 
together...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Ah, just as I thought... how dazzling...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You two, this is no time to be 
daydreaming. 
The next mission is 'Get Hyped Together at 
the Winning Live!'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Until we share our joy with everyone 
present here, 
our mission will not be fully complete.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely. We worked hard to win this 
stage, 
so let's make it a beautiful memory to 
last a lifetime. Here we go—

text_block_list.name: Five Stars
text_block_list.text:
Team Five Stars, ready— 
GOOOOOOO!!
